provenance.construction: Reconstructed from qecdb.org record 674f22cfd96c81d3c7c0bb7e (https://qecdb.org/codes/674f22cfd96c81d3c7c0bb7e); the record's H field is read as binary symplectic rows and split by rowspace (rank(A|B) = rank(A) + rank(B)), keeping the lightest independent basis of each part; n, k and the check weight recomputed here, witnesses from the kit's random search at the trials below. Database description: toric; database distance claim d=3 (lower 3, upper 3).
provenance.notes: Equivalence assessed against the board: no exact stabilizer-group fingerprint match and no Weisfeiler-Leman signature match to any existing entry. Filed as `codes/10-2-3-b.json`, a lighter-check companion to `codes/10-2-3-b.json` (same [[10,2,3]], max check weight 4 vs 6). LER data (X/Z, p=0.002/0.001) transferred from the equivalent base entry codes/10-2-3-b.json, whose circuit was verified by @FarLab.

contributed_by.method: Simulated annealing over site assignments on an integer grid with the repo's own research/local2d/fold_layout.search_layout (max-diameter objective, several bounding boxes and seeds); single layer at radius 4 tried first, then two layers at 7. Radius and per-site occupancy re-measured with the verifier's rule.

circuit.notes: Johnson-coil + 4 span flags sequential extraction (max_flags=2 per check, 4 X + 4 Z edge-colored data CX layers per round, coloring candidate 0); generated by qldpc submit (research/circuit_autogen.py, seed 0), the first of up to 6 candidates whose RIS screen at 2 rounds found nothing below d; witnesses from RIS on ker(H_dem) at twice the gate's trial budget, validated in GF(2)

contributed_by.method: circuit_autogen schedule search (two-block interleaved, then layout, then generic), verified by verify/circuit_verify.py before writing
